name: High Lord Athulf

facts.text: Athulf as the high lord who wants war is Living Server lore (Varulvhamn's 'high lords').

story:
Athulf wants war. Of the three high lords under the king, each holding a wing of the haven, he is the one who says the werewolves should have taken the dragon's offer, or Midgard's, or anyone's, so long as it meant going up out of the haven and taking something. He keeps the wargs, the frukta wargs that hunt in packs of their own, and his wing smells of them. His advisors advise him to wait. He keeps them for that, the wolfaur say, so that he has someone to refuse every morning.

The king's three natures listen to Athulf, and the wolf in the king agrees with him, the court says, and the man does not, and the thing between has not decided. Midgard's gothi send the young for his essence first, because if any lord of the haven is going to bring the werewolves up out of Varulvhamn against the realm, it is Athulf. He meets them in his wing with the wargs at his heels, glad of it.
legend: High Lord Athulf is a level 44 Varulv high lord in his wing of Varulvhamn, with frukta wargs (39-42), werewolf advisors and elite guards round him. One of the three lords for Werewolf Bane's essences. Varulv faction, and the room is packed with his wing. Bring a full group. Clear the wargs at the edges first; the advisors stand thick round him.

aggro: At last. Someone who wants to fight.
death: The war... will come... without me...
slay: That is how the werewolves should meet Midgard.

lairEntry: Warg-stink in the corridor. The high lord who wants war.
